name: Batonn
description: Batonn was a planet located in the Batonn sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Admiral Thrawn was victorious in the Batonn insurgency, which led to the Emperor promoting him to Grand Admiral.
